author: ItzAidan
body:
Hello Everyone
This is about how many people join Avicus a day. I don't know if mine is accurate or if its different from everyone else on how many people there are online when you join. But the highest I've ever seen is 192. I saw that torwards the afternoon and see 100 in the morning and 70-80 at night. I was wondering if there was any way to make this server more popular? Please leave feedback! 
Thanks!:D

title: As Many Players As Possible?

replies.author: AtditC
replies.body:
Fix block lag, fix any other lag.

Example: Mineplex has great plugins and almost no bugs, that's why it's so popular + big youtubers play on there.

If a big youtuber would play on Avicus, and realize block lag, then he wouldn't play on Avicus anymore + the subscribers of the youtuber would only play a few minutes until they will leave.

It's pretty easy, just fix the damn block lag.
